adaptation.geometry: Original glTF indexed meshes and normals. Node transforms baked, X/Z centred and base placed at Y=0, rounded to 6 decimals. No decimation or procedural replacement.
adaptation.materials: Deterministic flat-colour override: bollard MI_Trim_MetalConcrete -> metal; planter MI_Trim_MetalConcrete -> stone; MI_Dirt -> soil. Runtime uses CITY_PALETTE. Original base colour/normal/ORM textures, UVs and wear channels intentionally omitted; not a texture-faithful reproduction.
adaptation.excluded: No buildings, paid Source assets, scripts, shaders, textures or full archive shipped. Bench/bin/streetlamp/bike rack are absent from this free archive.
